correctness.rationale: For the fully specified 15-edge Petersen graphic matroid, the complete 4,680-by-2,000 top boundary over F2 has checked rank 1,760. The two embedded 2,000-bit seed cycles satisfy every boundary row. Their 240 images under all 120 permutations lie in the kernel and have binary column rank 240. No higher simplices exist; this gives an explicit basis of H8 and an F2[S5]^2 free-module isomorphism. Separate orbit ranks and cycle sizes are verified by exact integer bit computations. The claim is limited to characteristic two.

originality.rationale: The earlier determination of two rational regular summands for this exact forest complex is expressly recognized as prior; it is not the proposed finding. In characteristic two the group algebra is nonsemisimple and the rational character cannot prove freeness. The two explicitly indexed cycles and their 240 linearly independent mod-two translates are an additional, independently computed claim. A search of the available exact records, aliases, and inspected primary matroid literature did not reveal its modular orbit-basis theorem. Specialized unindexed treatments remain an acknowledged risk.
residual_risks: The modular module isomorphism could be contained in unindexed literature or implicit in a specialized representation calculation not located.
The finite certificate establishes F2-freeness only, not integral unimodularity.

value.rationale: This settles modular freeness of a natural 240-dimensional homology representation at a prime dividing the symmetry-group order. It is not determined by the known ordinary Betti number or the previously computed rational regular character, because modular representations are nonsemisimple. Two full geometric chain orbit bases and a complete reproducing certificate supply the precise new structural information.
